ينثقب (form VII)
# يَنْثَقِبُ (yanṯaqibu) /jan.θa.qi.bu/: third-person masculine singular non-past active indicative of اِنْثَقَبَ (inṯaqaba)
# يُنْثَقَبُ (yunṯaqabu) /jun.θa.qa.bu/: third-person masculine singular non-past passive indicative of اِنْثَقَبَ (inṯaqaba)
# يَنْثَقِبَ (yanṯaqiba) /jan.θa.qi.ba/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive of اِنْثَقَبَ (inṯaqaba)
# يُنْ
